role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 对于任何团队而言光之守卫都是坚实的后盾。敌友的魔法均在他掌控之下，弱小的敌人将在光芒的冲击下轻易毁灭，而他进入灵魂形态后还能召集团队发动奇袭。
hero_summary_en: Keeper of the Light is a helpful addition to any team. Manipulating the mana of both his allies and enemies, he effortlessly destroys lesser foes with waves of illumination, then enters his spirit form to gather his team to press the assault.

abilities.name: keeper_of_the_light_illuminate
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 引导光的能量，持续施法的时间越长，威力越大。释放后，光波沿直线向前发出，造成伤害并获得沿途的视野。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Channels light energy, building power the longer it's channeled.  Once released, a wave is sent forth that deals damage and gives vision in its path.  The longer it is channeled, the more damage is dealt.
notes_zh: 在持续施法期间获得的视野不断增大。
notes_en: Gives increasing vision over the channeling time.

abilities.name: keeper_of_the_light_blinding_light
abilities.description_zh: 一道致盲之光在目标区域闪现，把区域内的单位击退到区域边缘，并造成致盲，使他们的部分攻击不能命中。最短击退距离是在%knockback_duration%秒内击退%knockback_distance%距离。
abilities.description_en: A blinding light flashes over the targeted area, knocking back units to the edge of the area and blinding them, causing them to miss some attacks. Minimum knockback distance is %knockback_distance% range over %knockback_duration% seconds.
notes_zh: 落地后受作用单位将摧毁150范围内的树木。
notes_en: Upon landing, units will destroy trees in a 150 radius.

abilities.name: keeper_of_the_light_chakra_magic
abilities.description_zh: 恢复目标单位的魔法值，并减少所有冷却中基础技能（非大招）的冷却时间。对自身使用时效果提升%self_bonus%%%。
abilities.description_en: Restores mana to the target unit and reduces cooldowns of all basic abilities currently on cooldown by a fixed amount. Is %self_bonus%%% more effective when used on himself.
notes_zh: 查克拉魔法无法减少终极技能的冷却时间。
notes_en: Chakra Magic does not reduce the cooldown of Ultimate abilities.

abilities.name: keeper_of_the_light_radiant_bind
abilities.description_zh: 削弱一个敌人的魔法抗性，并施加减速效果，目标移动的距离越长，减速效果越大。
abilities.description_en: Weakens an enemy's magical resistance, and applies a slow that increases in strength the more the target moves.

abilities.name: keeper_of_the_light_will_o_wisp
abilities.description_zh: 在目标区域召唤幻火。幻火交替闪亮和闪灭。闪亮时蛊惑敌人靠近，并造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Summons Ignis Fatuus at the targeted area. Alternates on and off, drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker.
notes_zh: 幻火会对作用范围内所有敌人施加朝其牵引的效果，该牵引效果不会打断。
notes_en: Ignus Fatuus applies a non-interrupting pull towards it on all enemies within the radius.

abilities.name: keeper_of_the_light_spirit_form
abilities.description_zh: 伊扎洛暂时使身体发光，获得施法距离加成，提升光明速度的移速加成，并且冲击波将由一个单独的灵魂施法，可以治疗友军。
abilities.description_en: Ezalor temporarily turns his body luminescent, gaining cast range, increasing the speed bonus from Bright Speed, and allows Illuminate to be channeled by a separate spirit and heal allies.

shard_loc.zh: 提升冲击波的治疗效果。

facet_text_en: Grants the Solar Bind ability while active.
Grants the Recall ability while active.
facet_text_zh: 灵魂形态生效时获得炎阳之缚技能。

abilities.name: keeper_of_the_light_bright_speed
abilities.description_zh: 光之守卫每%intelligence_per_speed%点智力都会获得1移动速度。只要光之守卫移动%movement_per_vision%距离，他就会留下一道光，可以看到%vision_radius%范围，持续%vision_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Keeper of the Light gains 1 movement speed for every %intelligence_per_speed% Intelligence.Whenever Keeper of the Light moves %movement_per_vision% distance, he leaves behind light that allows him to see %vision_radius% range for %vision_duration% seconds.
